notes: Added the Pocket dashboard theme with a Game Boy-inspired pixel interface and adaptive GT7 telemetry presentation.
Added pixel-style RPM, lap, position, timing, fuel, ABS and TCS indicators optimized for 320 x 240 displays.
Improved Pocket driving-aid redraw isolation to prevent fuel, ABS and TCS indicators from flickering together.
Refined Pocket iconography, layout spacing, typography and shift-light visibility through physical display testing.
Added the Mono dashboard theme with a minimalist black-and-white digital instrument layout.
Added a segmented monochrome shift-light, dynamic GT7 alert marker and shift-warning pulse.
Refined Mono timing, position, lap, delta, fuel, remaining-lap, tyre, pedal and driving-aid presentation for 320 x 240 displays.
Improved Classic dashboard recovery when a temporary sprite allocation fails after switching themes.
Redesigned Theme Selection with live renderer previews and fixed mock telemetry data.
Added looping theme navigation, compact applied/preview indicators, and persistent Apply or non-destructive Cancel actions.
Added a full-screen theme preview with a clear tap-to-return control.
Centralized the theme catalog and decoupled Classic and GT3 renderers from live telemetry for easier future theme expansion.
Kept heartbeat, UDP telemetry, discovery, Wi-Fi and sleep handling independent from theme preview rendering.
Improved Radar theme readability with larger lap, position, fuel, remaining-lap and delta values.
Refined Radar lap formatting with compact spacing around the separator.
Improved Retro theme readability with larger current time, fuel, remaining-lap, lap and position values.
Adjusted Retro current-time and delta placement to prevent overlap.
Added switchable GT3, Classic, and Retro dashboard themes with persistent on-device selection; GT3 remains the default.
Added the touch Settings menu: tap an active display to open Settings, or tap a sleeping display to wake it.
Added Device Settings with persistent 20–100% brightness control and protected Wi-Fi reset access.
Refined the Classic min-alert RPM marker and increased Retro gear readability.
Added telemetry-driven RPM colours and progressive GT7 shift-warning pulse.
Introduced the refined low-RAM GT3 dashboard UI.
Added tyre-temperature colour display.
Added ST7789 display support.
